headline: Haryana shopkeepers rejoice: PM-WANI will bring public Wi-Fi to shops... a new path to earnings opens
summary: Under PM-WANI, grocery stores, cyber cafes and Common Service Centres in villages can become public internet access points, creating new earning opportunities.
why: PM-WANI is a government program to expand public Wi-Fi access in India, which affects telecom data demand and small retail service revenue.

backfill_provenance.description_from: publisher page metadata, translated to English by Claude

original_headline: Haryana में दुकानदारों की बल्ले-बल्ले, PM-WANI से दुकानों पर लगेगा सार्वजनिक Wi-Fi... कमाई का खुलेगा नया रास्ता
